description: Property listings from one portal per call: Redfin and Realtor.com (United States), Property Finder (UAE), Magicbricks and NoBroker (India), Property24 (South Africa) or Emlakjet (Turkey). Returns price, address, beds, baths, area, property type, listing status and link. Suited to home search and housing-market questions. $0.02 per call, up to 25 listings.

input.description: Advanced: a JSON object with the site's own filters; GET /sites lists them per site.

location.description: City, region or postcode as the site understands it, e.g. "Berlin".

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the portal currency.

minArea.description: Minimum area (m² or ft² as the portal uses).

minPrice.description: Minimum price in the portal currency.

propertyType.description: A property type the portal accepts (see /properties/sites).

searchUrl.description: Instead of query/location: a full search-results link from the site, with its filters.

site.description: Portal key from /properties/sites, e.g. redfin, realtor, propertyfinder, property24.

transaction.description: sale or rent (where the portal has both).

name: properties_search
title: Property listings on one portal
